metadata.question: On August 3, 2025, were there more than 120 fires active in Saskatchewan, Canada?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy Collection: MODIS/006/MCD14DL (active-fire hotspot product). Date: filter on 2025-08-03 (already available). Region: the province of Saskatchewan (approximate EE FeatureCollection available via “users/ross-sask/Saskatchewan”). 2. Masking strategy MCD14DL already flags confidence; we accept only valid fire pixels (confidence ≠ 8 and ≠ 9) in the “confidence” band. 3. Logic to distinguish Valid Zero from Null/Error - Collection size = 0 → C1. - Positive size but zero valid pixels after masking → C2. - Count is ≥ 0 integer; if it is exactly None or NaN → C3. - else: compare vs 120 and answer A/B accordingly. ```python import ee ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113') # 1 Geometry & Time geom = ee.FeatureCollection("users/ross-sask/Saskatchewan").geometry() target_date = '2025-08-03' # 2 Data Acquisition & Size Check col = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL') .filterDate(target_date, target_date) .filterBounds(geom)) n_imgs = col.size().getInfo() if n_imgs == 0: print("No fire images for 2025-08-03.") print("C1") else: # 3 Processing: keep only valid fire pixels valid_col = (col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('confidence').neq(8) .And(img.select('confidence').neq(9)))) .select('FireMask')) # Count pixels inside Saskatchewan pixel_count = (valid_col.first() # only one day, so single image .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(), geometry=geom, scale=1000, maxPixels=1e9) .get('FireMask').getInfo()) # 4 Validation & Answer if pixel_count is None or pixel_count != pixel_count: # NaN trap print("Calculation failed: None/NaN result.") print("C3") elif pixel_count == 0: print("No valid fire pixels.") print("C2") else: print(f"2025-08-03 fires: {pixel_count}") print("A" if pixel_count > 120 else "B") ```
data.code:
import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1 Geometry & Time
geom = ee.FeatureCollection("users/ross-sask/Saskatchewan").geometry()
target_date = '2025-08-03'

# 2 Data Acquisition & Size Check
col = (ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MCD14DL')
         .filterDate(target_date, target_date)
         .filterBounds(geom))
n_imgs = col.size().getInfo()

if n_imgs == 0:
    print("No fire images for 2025-08-03.")
    print("<answer>C1</answer>")
else:
    # 3 Processing: keep only valid fire pixels
    valid_col = (col.map(lambda img: img.updateMask(img.select('confidence').neq(8)
                                                         .And(img.select('confidence').neq(9))))
                   .select('FireMask'))
    
    # Count pixels inside Saskatchewan
    pixel_count = (valid_col.first()  # only one day, so single image
                   .reduceRegion(reducer=ee.Reducer.count(),
                                 geometry=geom,
                                 scale=1000,
                                 maxPixels=1e9)
                   .get('FireMask').getInfo())
    
    # 4 Validation & Answer
    if pixel_count is None or pixel_count != pixel_count:  # NaN trap
        print("Calculation failed: None/NaN result.")
        print("<answer>C3</answer>")
    elif pixel_count == 0:
        print("No valid fire pixels.")
        print("<answer>C2</answer>")
    else:
        print(f"2025-08-03 fires: {pixel_count}")
        print("<answer>A</answer>" if pixel_count > 120 else "<answer>B</answer>")
